gates: The imposed separation crosses from positive to zero to negative while the element remains active.
For ISYM=0, confirm tensile damage is retained but the negative normal traction follows the undegraded compressive stiffness branch.
No separate contact interface is present on the same coincident faces, so compressive reaction is not double counted.
limits: No duplicate INTER contact is placed on the coincident cohesive faces; LAW117 ISYM=0 supplies the material's own undamaged compression branch.
A successful process exit is only deck/runtime admission, not material calibration or physical qualification.
Check kinetic/internal-energy ratio and global energy balance before interpreting the force curve as quasi-static.

The T01 reaction channels are impulses. /TH/TITLE must generate the T01_TITLES sidecar, and th_to_csv must derive the titled REACX/REACY/REACZ channels before they are treated as forces; generic varNN columns do not pass the force gate.

The Engine uses /DT/NODA/STOP with a 0.02 critical-step scale, a 1e-12 s minimum-step stop floor, and no requested mass scaling. Verify the actual cycle count and zero mass change in the native output before interpreting the refined history.

The official OpenCourant README and converter describe T01 reaction channels as impulses; /TH/TITLE writes the title sidecar used by th_to_csv to identify and difference recognized reaction tokens. This is an output-processing prerequisite, not independent force validation.
observables: top-node displacement and velocity histories (DX/DY/DZ, VX/VY/VZ)
sum of four constrained bottom-node reaction forces in the driven direction (N)
cohesive brick global stress, strain, internal energy and deactivation flag
engine energy history and restart state for split runs
analysis.purpose: Partial mode-I opening, closure through zero, then small normal compression under the asymmetric LAW117 branch.

synthetic_reference.scope: quasistatic pure-mode-I calibration of this synthetic law only
synthetic_reference.source_equation: Pinned sigeps117.F90 linear displacement evolution: delta0=TN/EN, deltaf=2*GIC/TN; D=(deltaf/delta)*(delta-delta0)/(deltaf-delta0), then T=(1-D)*EN*delta for tensile normal opening.
synthetic_reference.work_basis: triangle under the source-derived tensile traction-gap curve; GIC=1.5 N/mm times 1 mm^2 bond area gives 1.5 N mm

force_conversion.conversion: finite difference of impulse over time; inspect titled CSV columns and units before applying force/work gates
force_conversion.converter_provenance: th_to_csv is an external OpenCourant/Tools utility, not part of the pinned OpenCourant source tree; bind its actual binary/version in any future run receipt
force_conversion.force_gate_blocked_if: the titles sidecar is missing or the CSV contains generic varNN columns instead of titled reaction channels

time_step_control.note: Pinned CFG STOP card has only scale/minimum fields; no mass scaling is requested. A native run must still confirm zero mass change.
